name: congress-trading-pipeline
title: Congress Trading Pipeline
description: Fetches U.S. Senate Periodic Transaction Reports (PTRs) directly from efdsearch.senate.gov, normalizes them into a clean schema, and pushes them to a queryable dataset of STOCK Act disclosures.

input.title: Congress Trading Pipeline Input
input.description: Optional overrides for the pipeline run.

fetchDaysBack.title: Days back to fetch
fetchDaysBack.description: Rolling window of PTRs to fetch (default 90). The window is applied to the FILING date (the date the PTR was submitted to the Senate), not to the trade date inside it.

fromDate.title: From date (YYYY-MM-DD)
fromDate.description: Explicit start of the filing-date window. Overrides fetchDaysBack if set.

toDate.title: To date (YYYY-MM-DD)
toDate.description: Explicit end of the filing-date window. Defaults to today.

debugPtrLimit.title: Debug: limit PTR detail fetches
debugPtrLimit.description: If > 0, fetch detail HTML for only the first N PTRs (after the members filter). Useful for diagnostics and cheap test runs.

members.title: Members (names)
members.description: Optional. Only return filings by these senators. Case-insensitive; matches the normalized name and common nicknames, so "Tommy Tuberville" matches "Thomas H Tuberville". A bioguide id (e.g. T000278) also works, and a bare last name matches every senator with that last name. Applied before each filing's detail page is fetched, so excluded senators are never fetched or charged.

tickers.title: Tickers
tickers.description: Optional. Only return transactions in these tickers (case-insensitive, e.g. AAPL, BRK.B). Rows with no ticker are excluded when this is set, and so are placeholder rows (their content is unknown). Applied before rows are written or charged.

transactionDateFrom.title: Transaction date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
transactionDateFrom.description: Optional. Only return transactions executed on or after this date. Applied on top of the filing-date window: a trade is only returned if its filing falls inside the window too. Filings filed before this date are skipped without fetching their detail page.

transactionDateTo.title: Transaction date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
transactionDateTo.description: Optional. Only return transactions executed on or before this date. Applied on top of the filing-date window.

includeDuplicates.title: Keep exact duplicate rows
includeDuplicates.description: By default, a trade that appears identically in more than one filing (e.g. an original PTR and the amendment that re-lists it) is returned once, from the amendment. Set to true to keep every copy; supersedes_filing_id / is_superseded are still set.
